sloka: विशेषेण भवान् एव विश्वामित्र महायशः ।कौशिकी सरिताम् श्रेष्ठः कुल उद्योतकरी तव ॥१-३४-२१॥
transliteration: viśeṣeṇa bhavān eva viśvāmitra mahāyaśaḥ ।kauśikī saritām śreṣṭhaḥ kula udyotakarī tava ॥1-34-21॥

translations.english: "Highly illustrious Viswamitra, you are similar to Brahma. Among the rivers, Kausiki is the best, refurbishing the image of your dynasty".
